generate_h2_header_frame: generate an HPACK-encoded HTTP/2 header frame from colon-separated headers on stdin
encode_never_indexed_headers: encode HTTP headers using never-indexed HPACK compression without adding to the dynamic table
encode_inc_indexed_headers: encode HTTP headers using incremental indexing HPACK compression with literal key and value
encode_pre_indexed_headers: encode HTTP headers using pre-indexed HPACK compression referencing the static table
output_header_frame_as_hex: output the generated HTTP/2 header frame payload as a hex byte array
